name: hoian-elder-whispers-backtranslation
title: Hoian Elder Whisper Back-Translation
purpose_md: The Cărțile Hoiane is a fictional divination tradition from a lost 1840s Transylvanian principality. Each of its 36 card families carries an elder whisper (Șoapta Pădurii, the Forest's Whisper): one sentence that belongs to all four of the family's rememberings, printed bilingually RO/EN on the family page. We are validating the Romanian half of every elder whisper by blind back-translation: you translate our English sentence into Romanian first, and only afterwards see our canon Romanian and assess it.
register_md:
The tradition's Romanian is **rural, liturgical-leaning, mid-19th-century Transylvanian**. Where a modern word and an older/folk/liturgical word both exist, the tradition prefers the older one. Orthography is modern standard Romanian with **comma-below diacritics (ș, ț — never ş, ţ)**.

Whispers are **complete one-sentence utterances**, aphoristic and grave: the Forest addressing the seeker. They are not headlines and not proverbs quoted from elsewhere; they are spoken TO someone. Preserve the sentence shape, person, and tense of the English. In print they are set in „Romanian low-high quotes”; do not include the quote marks in your rendering.
part2_checks_md: Also check: comma-below diacritics throughout; natural spoken word order (not calqued English order); person and tense faithful to the English.

verdict_definitions.correct: idiomatic, grammatical, register-appropriate; a Romanian villager of 1845 could say it
verdict_definitions.archaic-good: non-obvious or old-fashioned phrasing that suits the register (name the modern phrasing it beats)
verdict_definitions.questionable: defensible but you would phrase it differently (say what and why)
verdict_definitions.wrong: grammatical error, wrong sense, false friend, or wrong diacritics (explain)

pairs.en: He who wears the crown promised something to the forest, and the forest does not forget.
pairs.ro: Ce poartă coroana a promis ceva pădurii, și pădurea nu uită.
pairs.context: elder whisper of Principele (The Prince), card 1 — the phrase shared by all four rememberings

pairs.en: My eyes are in the forest now; be careful what you show them.
pairs.ro: Ochii mei sunt în pădure acum; ai grijă ce le arăți.
pairs.context: elder whisper of Nevăzătorul (The Unseeing), card 2 — the phrase shared by all four rememberings

pairs.en: What you see beneath the veil is not for your eyes; but she knows what is beneath yours.
pairs.ro: Ce vezi sub voal nu-i pentru ochii tăi; dar ea știe ce-i sub-al tău.
pairs.context: elder whisper of Vălata (The Veiled One), card 3 — the phrase shared by all four rememberings

pairs.en: You opened the door. The forest saw.
pairs.ro: Ai deschis ușa. Pădurea a văzut.
pairs.context: elder whisper of Oaspetele Interzis (The Forbidden Guest), card 4 — the phrase shared by all four rememberings

pairs.en: What he took was not his, but the forest road does not ask.
pairs.ro: Ce a luat nu era al lui, dar drumul din pădure nu întreabă.
pairs.context: elder whisper of Hoțul (The Thief), card 5 — the phrase shared by all four rememberings

pairs.en: His scale is honest at the market; but the forest sells nothing.
pairs.ro: Cântarul lui e drept la piață; dar pădurea nu vinde nimic.
pairs.context: elder whisper of Negustorul (The Merchant), card 6 — the phrase shared by all four rememberings

pairs.en: He comes with papers and guns, but the forest reads neither.
pairs.ro: Vine cu hârtii și puști, dar pădurea nu citește nici una.
pairs.context: elder whisper of Ofițerul (The Officer), card 7 — the phrase shared by all four rememberings

pairs.en: His name was never spoken, but the forest remembered it anyway.
pairs.ro: Numele lui nu a fost rostit, dar pădurea l-a ținut minte oricum.
pairs.context: elder whisper of Născutul Mort (The Stillborn), card 8 — the phrase shared by all four rememberings

pairs.en: Two at the forest's edge, one heart between them: the forest sees the third.
pairs.ro: Doi la marginea pădurii, o singură inimă între ei: pădurea o vede pe-a treia.
pairs.context: elder whisper of Iubitul/Iubita (The Lover), card 9 — the phrase shared by all four rememberings

pairs.en: The forest has seen every face you have worn: including the one you hide from yourself.
pairs.ro: Pădurea a văzut toate fețele pe care le-ai purtat: și pe cea pe care o ascunzi de tine însuți.
pairs.context: elder whisper of Dușmanul (The Enemy), card 10 — the phrase shared by all four rememberings

pairs.en: What was sworn at the font, the forest heard through the walls.
pairs.ro: Ce s-a jurat la cristelniță, pădurea a auzit prin pereți.
pairs.context: elder whisper of Nașul (The Godfather), card 11 — the phrase shared by all four rememberings

pairs.en: He walks the old path because no one has told him he is allowed to stop.
pairs.ro: Merge pe drumul vechi pentru că nimeni nu i-a spus că poate să se oprească.
pairs.context: elder whisper of Rătăcitorul (The Wanderer), card 12 — the phrase shared by all four rememberings

pairs.en: You have been here before. Three times. The forest did not move: you moved through it.
pairs.ro: Ai mai fost aici. De trei ori. Pădurea nu s-a mutat: tu te-ai mutat prin ea.
pairs.context: elder whisper of Nehartă (The Uncharted), card 13 — the phrase shared by all four rememberings

pairs.en: You cannot go around what must be crossed. The forest has no edge.
pairs.ro: Nu poți ocoli ce trebuie traversat. Pădurea nu are margine.
pairs.context: elder whisper of Trecerea (The Passage), card 14 — the phrase shared by all four rememberings

pairs.en: The house is gone, but the forest still feels the warmth where the hearth stood.
pairs.ro: Casa a plecat, dar pădurea încă simte căldura unde a fost vatra.
pairs.context: elder whisper of Vatra de Piatră (The Hearth of Stone), card 15 — the phrase shared by all four rememberings

pairs.en: What is written on paper can burn. What is written in the forest remains.
pairs.ro: Ce e scris pe hârtie se poate arde. Ce e scris în pădure rămâne.
pairs.context: elder whisper of Cuvântul Pecetluit (The Sealed Word), card 16 — the phrase shared by all four rememberings

pairs.en: Four roads, and beneath one of them, someone who never had a choice.
pairs.ro: Patru drumuri, și sub unul dintre ele, cineva care n-a avut de ales.
pairs.context: elder whisper of Răspântia (The Crossroads), card 17 — the phrase shared by all four rememberings

pairs.en: The elders speak, but the forest carries out the sentence.
pairs.ro: Bătrânii vorbesc, dar pădurea execută sentința.
pairs.context: elder whisper of Judecată (The Trial), card 18 — the phrase shared by all four rememberings

pairs.en: The crowns were placed, but the forest heard only half a ‘yes.’
pairs.ro: Cununile s-au pus, dar pădurea a auzit doar o jumătate de «da».
pairs.context: elder whisper of Nuntă (The Wedding), card 19 — the phrase shared by all four rememberings

pairs.en: The grave is dug, but the forest waits to see if it stays closed.
pairs.ro: Groapa e săpată, dar pădurea așteaptă să vadă dacă rămâne închisă.
pairs.context: elder whisper of Înmormântarea (The Funeral), card 20 — the phrase shared by all four rememberings

pairs.en: Both of them know. Both of them chose to know no longer.
pairs.ro: Amândoi știu. Amândoi au ales să nu mai știe.
pairs.context: elder whisper of Tăcerea (The Silence), card 21 — the phrase shared by all four rememberings

pairs.en: The one you await passed through the forest. The forest did not let him leave.
pairs.ro: Cel pe care-l aștepți a trecut prin pădure. Pădurea nu l-a lăsat să iasă.
pairs.context: elder whisper of Masa Goală (The Empty Table), card 22 — the phrase shared by all four rememberings

pairs.en: The trees went silent before the wind. They know before we do.
pairs.ro: Copacii au tăcut înaintea vântului. Ei știu mai devreme decât noi.
pairs.context: elder whisper of Furtună (The Storm), card 23 — the phrase shared by all four rememberings

pairs.en: Throw a stone and listen. If you hear nothing, do not lean in further.
pairs.ro: Aruncă o piatră și ascultă. Dacă nu auzi nimic, nu te apleca mai mult.
pairs.context: elder whisper of Fântâna (The Well), card 24 — the phrase shared by all four rememberings

pairs.en: The key opens the door. The forest made the door.
pairs.ro: Cheia deschide ușa. Pădurea a făcut ușa.
pairs.context: elder whisper of Cheia (The Key), card 25 — the phrase shared by all four rememberings

pairs.en: A circle has no beginning. The forest knows where it closed, even if you have forgotten.
pairs.ro: Un cerc nu are început. Pădurea știe unde s-a strâns, chiar dacă tu ai uitat.
pairs.context: elder whisper of Inelul (The Ring), card 26 — the phrase shared by all four rememberings

pairs.en: It is ready for someone. The forest knows for whom, but does not tell you yet.
pairs.ro: E gata pentru cineva. Pădurea știe pentru cine, dar nu-ți spune încă.
pairs.context: elder whisper of Sicriul (The Coffin), card 27 — the phrase shared by all four rememberings

pairs.en: It beats and the forest hears it. The head can lie; the heart does not know how.
pairs.ro: Bate și pădurea o aude. Capul poate minți; inima nu știe cum.
pairs.context: elder whisper of Inimă (The Heart), card 28 — the phrase shared by all four rememberings

pairs.en: Your roots are in my soil. What holds you upright is also what draws you toward me.
pairs.ro: Rădăcinile tale sunt în pământul meu. Ce te ține în picioare e și ceea ce te trage spre mine.
pairs.context: elder whisper of Rădăcina (The Root), card 29 — the phrase shared by all four rememberings

pairs.en: It holds the place. It does not ask if you still wish to stay.
pairs.ro: Ține locul. Nu întreabă dacă mai vrei să stai.
pairs.context: elder whisper of Piatră (The Stone), card 30 — the phrase shared by all four rememberings

pairs.en: The sun shows everything. The forest still holds what shadow hid.
pairs.ro: Soarele arată tot. Pădurea încă ține ce umbra a ascuns.
pairs.context: elder whisper of Soarele (The Sun), card 31 — the phrase shared by all four rememberings

pairs.en: What the moon shows is no lie: it is only truth told differently.
pairs.ro: Ce arată luna nu-i minciună: e doar adevărul spus altfel.
pairs.context: elder whisper of Luna (The Moon), card 32 — the phrase shared by all four rememberings

pairs.en: A star does not promise the whole road. The forest has watched many follow it: some arrived.
pairs.ro: O stea nu promite drumul întreg. Pădurea a văzut mulți urmărind-o: unii au ajuns.
pairs.context: elder whisper of Steaua (The Star), card 33 — the phrase shared by all four rememberings

pairs.en: The book is written by humans. The forest keeps what they did not dare to write.
pairs.ro: Cartea e scrisă de oameni. Pădurea ține ce n-au îndrăznit să scrie.
pairs.context: elder whisper of Cartea (The Book), card 34 — the phrase shared by all four rememberings

pairs.en: Do not look long. What looks back remembers better than you do.
pairs.ro: Nu te uita mult. Ce se uită înapoi ține minte mai bine decât tine.
pairs.context: elder whisper of Adâncul (The Deep), card 35 — the phrase shared by all four rememberings

pairs.en: Humans count in coins. The forest counts in bones.
pairs.ro: Oamenii socotesc în monede. Pădurea socotește în oase.
pairs.context: elder whisper of Datoria (The Debt), card 36 — the phrase shared by all four rememberings
